units.source_text: 幸好这一带气温急剧变化，日落前三十分钟到一个小时，地表上肯定会腾起薄薄的雾气。

en.t: Fortunately, temperatures in this area changed rapidly, and from thirty minutes to an hour before sunset a thin mist was sure to rise from the surface of the ground.

units.source_text: 这是由于，热容量很少的沙子中的硅酸，白天把热量吸了个足，到了傍晚又把热量忽地喷出来。

en.t: This was because the silicic acid in the sand, which had very little heat capacity, soaked up heat all day and then suddenly released it again toward evening.

units.source_text: 从瞭望哨那边看过来，这边正巧是逆光，所以，即使少量的薄雾，也会成为厚厚的乳色幕障，一定能将视线完全挡住。

en.t: Seen from the lookout post, this side would be exactly against the light, so even a small amount of thin mist would become a thick milky curtain and would surely block the view completely.

units.source_text: 为了慎重起见，昨天他特地验证了这一点。

en.t: To be on the safe side, he had gone out of his way yesterday to verify this point.

units.source_text: 他从靠海一边的坝下，挥了几下手巾，打了好些信号，可跟预想的一样，那边没有任何反应。

en.t: From below the embankment on the seaward side, he waved his handkerchief several times and sent a number of signals, but just as he had expected, there was no response at all from the other side.
